name: Huymaier Console FSE Shell, Storefront & Artwork Integration
features: keeps Quick Access exclusive to Huymaier Console while adding a separate external-game/app Huymaier Game Bar
separates physical Guide/Xbox/PS/Home from Xbox View/Back and PlayStation Share/Create
preserves the runtime-tested v0.26.0 native Huymaier Game Bar, task switcher, DPI scaling, fullscreen preservation, popup navigation, and Guide behavior
builds the GameInput bridge as x64 with the static MSVC runtime and ships the Microsoft GameInput redistributable
builds and installs the exact x64 HuymaierConsole.exe and FSE host validated by Windows CI instead of recompiling application binaries on client PCs
uses a closed SHA-256 package manifest as the authoritative managed-file list and rejects missing, tampered, duplicate, traversing, or unchecksummed payload
uses a persistent incomplete-install marker plus managed-file rollback so interrupted or failed updates cannot silently launch a mixed-version installation
fails startup closed when the installed manifest, native Game Bar host, or system-button bridge is missing or inconsistent
verifies the SHA-256 asset published with GitHub Releases before self-update installation
keeps Xbox Game Bar suppression limited to controller-button takeover and restores the user's prior setting on normal exit, recovery, next sign-in, and uninstall
keeps FSE Home registration per-user without changing machine-wide Developer Mode policy
removes obsolete parallel updater and Guide bridge implementations
description: v0.26.1 is the system-integrity hotfix for Huymaier Console: exact-artifact Windows packaging, closed package verification, transactional/fail-closed install and update behavior, reversible Windows setting ownership, x64 dependency parity, and removal of stale parallel runtime paths.
